MissionCtrl does not create a key by itself. Create one here or import one you have. The app also asks for one when you add your first server.

Private keys are stored only in this app, encrypted with the Android Keystore. After a reinstall or on a new phone they are gone – unless you exported them. An export is always encrypted with a passphrase.
You won\'t be able to log in to servers that use this key anymore.

Downloads only when you tap, directly from huggingface.co (ggerganov/whisper.cpp), no account needed. The app checks every file against its checksum. Recognition runs on the phone; the audio never leaves it. Words and replacements below also apply to Whisper.

Colored history, wrapped to the phone\'s width. The pane on the laptop stays as it is.
A real terminal, live: use vim, htop, menus and Claude directly. Swipe up and down to scroll. The keyboard button opens the text field; the terminal button in it sends every key straight to the pane.

While it is open, the pane has the phone\'s size, on the laptop too: there it shrinks and its content rewraps. The pane only gets its size back when you leave the TUI or the app goes to the background.

How long a pane\'s TUI stays connected after you swipe away or leave the terminal. Longer: swiping back is live immediately. Shorter: the pane gets its size back on the laptop sooner, and less data flows. When the app goes to the background, the TUI closes immediately. Either way, the last frame stays visible until the connection is back.
